title: Logarithm of the reciprocal Gaussian density ratio
statement: For every real number $t>0$, the logarithm of the reciprocal of the standard Gaussian density at $t$, divided by $t$, is $t^2/2 + \log t + \log\sqrt{2\pi}$.
